discrepancy_explanation: EXPECTED, not an error. The co-processed panel is ascertained across all 376 samples and therefore retains loci that are monomorphic within the Mijangos et al. (2022) 218-sample panel; neither the Mijangos-only report nor the CloneID intersection ever contained them. Including them lowers every population mean H_E. Absolute H_E is therefore NOT comparable to the published Table 1 values and all KI-versus-mainland claims are made in relative terms.
